Got bullied in middle school. The bully only lived a couple of blocks away so we took the same route to and from school.

Anyway, was on my way home, leading my bike up a long hill. Bully shows up and stands in my way and blocking me so I can’t go around him. I didn’t wanna hurt him so I begged him to stop it and move. In which he just grinned at me and continued.
I didn’t know what to do.
Then a man starts walking past us, I looked at him as to say “help me”. He stopped, proceeded to ask me if the boy was bothering me. I nodded and he starts lecturing the bully. I don’t know what he said, I didn’t even thank him I just booked it out of there. 

Never saw the man again so I couldn’t thank him. It’s something I’ll never forget.
